caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling an ornate, stylized animal brooch, possibly a fibula, with a curved body and two pointed extensions at the bottom that resemble legs ending in animal head motifs. The object features a combination of green, gold, and ivory/white colors, with the center section decorated with circular gold elements, dots, and a lattice pattern. There are four smaller bird-like figures on top of the curved section, oriented in different directions, and additional decorative protrusions along the upper edge. The two lower extensions have repeated oval green motifs and circular golden elements, while each ends in intricate, looped animal head shapes facing outward. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with minimal detail except for the decorative object. In the lower right corner, there is a small signature or inscription.
title: Tobacco Cutter
